description:
Impeccably designed to offer a refined lifestyle with spacious layouts and generous outdoor living areas, Las Mesas Infinity Homes features 18 luxury sea view apartments for sale in Estepona, spread across three low-rise buildings. Each home blends modern architecture with thoughtful touches that create a bright, airy environment perfectly suited to coastal living.

The living spaces are open and bathed in natural light, with kitchens finished in quartz and fitted with Bosch appliances. Every element is precise, combining utility with crisp lines and a quiet sense of luxury. Dining and lounge areas open to the outdoors, where mornings begin with light from the sea and evenings end under a changing sky. Bedrooms are calm and considered, with built-in wardrobes and soft natural light. Primary suites feature private terrace access and bathrooms finished in porcelain, complete with walk-in showers and subtle lighting accents.

Each apartment extends outward with a spacious private terrace designed for daily living. Whether it’s a quiet morning coffee alone or an evening shared with friends, these generous outdoor spaces offer room to breathe, relax, and take in the full sweep of the Mediterranean. The apartments are equally suited to full-time living or seasonal escapes, offering flexibility in a home base that adapts to your rhythm. Penthouses bring an additional sense of elevation, with rooftop spaces offering wide, uninterrupted views and room to unwind above it all.

Residents have access to a carefully considered range of amenities that capture the feel of an exclusive coastal retreat. A dedicated wellness centre includes a gym, Turkish bath, and sauna, offering space to recharge both body and mind. The freshwater pool sits among landscaped gardens planted with native flora, creating a calm and natural backdrop throughout the year. A relaxed bar area provides a casual place to gather or enjoy a brief escape. Thoughtful sustainability is built into the fabric of the development, with solar panels supporting communal areas, aerothermal systems providing energy-efficient hot water, and EV charging points ready for use.

Estepona continues to evolve, balancing its coastal heritage with a growing sense of cultural energy. From galleries and street markets to water sports and family-run cafés, there is always something to explore. Beyond the marina and old town, the region offers even more. Spend a morning in the inland villages of the Sierra Bermeja or head along the coast to Sotogrande for golf or a long lunch. Marbella and Puerto Banus are nearby for designer shopping and nightlife, while Malaga and Gibraltar airports make international travel easy. Living in Estepona means enjoying the charm of the coast with the comfort of modern infrastructure and everyday convenience.

Las Mesas Infinity Homes is for those who value location, quality, and views that shift with the seasons. To arrange a private viewing or learn more about availability, please get in touch.
